vetoes.source: crossterm 0.29.0 src/event/source/unix/mio.rs:198-217 pushes bytes into a retained Vec until parse succeeds; src/event/sys/unix/parse.rs:813-822 waits for the paste terminator then allocates String. ex_ratatui 0.13.0 native/ex_ratatui/src/events.rs:21,42 forwards Paste(String).

ratatui-core 0.1.2 src/buffer/cell_width.rs:24-43 uses UnicodeWidthStr::width for ordinary string cells. Low-level CellDiffOption::ForcedWidth exists, but ex_ratatui 0.13.0 exposes no declared-width paint or ambiguous-width option; its Paragraph/text integration cannot select wide layout.

ex_ratatui 0.13.0 native/ex_ratatui/src/terminal.rs:88-97 init_terminal(focus_events, mouse_capture) always enables raw mode then executes EnterAlternateScreen; public init has no alternate-screen flag.
